name: sena-inventario
description: Sistema de Gestión de Inventario para el SENA - Ambiente 104 sede Quirigüá

scripts.db:reset: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose exec api npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec api npx prisma db seed
scripts.test: docker compose exec api npm test && docker compose exec client npm test
